topic: A person learns their childhood best friend doesn't remember them
text: It's hard to wrap my head around it. How can someone just... forget? We were inseparable, the kind of friends who shared everything. I can still recall every detail of our adventures, the secrets we whispered under the blanket, the way we laughed until our sides hurt. Now, when I reach out, it’s like I’m talking to a stranger. It feels like a part of me is just... gone. I don’t understand how memories can just vanish, especially ones that mean so much. It’s like trying to hold sand in my hands; the harder I try to keep them, the faster they slip away.
